papers.title: Learn What's Left, Not What's Mastered: Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization
papers.desc: Reinforcement learning (RL) with group-relative advantages has become the de facto standard for post-training language model reasoners.

papers.title: Large Discovery Models: Empirically-grounded Model-Based Open-Ended Search
papers.desc: Scientific discovery often involves optimising expensive-to-evaluate objectives over vast, structured, and open-ended hypothesis spaces, such as molecules, protein sequences, and computer programs.

papers.title: MOSS-VL Technical Report
papers.desc: We present MOSS-VL, an open vision-language model family that treats real-time interaction -- perceiving while it speaks -- as a first-class capability.

papers.title: How Do Agents Fail on AutoResearch: End-to-End Diagnostic Evaluation on 100 Real-World Frontier Research Tasks
papers.desc: AI has long assisted scientific research, but the rapid advance of LLMs and agentic scaffolds is reshaping the landscape; a single system can now carry whole-stage research from an initial hypothesis all the way to final published paper, which is a paradigm now referred to as AutoResearch.

papers.title: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-α, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
papers.desc: This first release of Prior Labs in relational learning shows our continued commitment to open science.

papers.title: GRNEdit: Efficient General Video Editing from a New Binary-Evidence Perspective in Generative Refinement Networks
papers.desc: Instruction-based general video editing seeks to unify diverse editing operations within a single, intuitive interface.

papers.title: TRACE-Bench: Decomposing and Diagnosing Multi-Reference Image Generation
papers.desc: Despite recent advances in unified multimodal models for multi-reference image generation, existing benchmarks remain organized around predefined task types (e.g., "subject composition"), which are ill-suited to this combinatorial setting and lead to fragmented coverage, uncontrolled complexity, and little diagnostic value.

papers.title: AnyTalk: Speech Animation for Arbitrary Characters Leveraging a Video Generation Model
papers.desc: We present AnyTalk, a novel method for generating 3D speech animations for arbitrary characters without requiring any animation data.

papers.title: DumpsterCluster: From Dumpster Diving to Serving LLaMA-70B on $60 GPUs
papers.desc: As AI datacenters retire functional GPUs, vast quantities of still capable accelerators enter secondary markets.

papers.title: Drive, Pack, Fly: The Travelling Thief Problem with Drone
papers.desc: In collection operations, accumulating payload progressively slows the vehicle, imposing a cumulative penalty on routing efficiency.

papers.title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency
papers.desc: Automated checking pipelines increasingly place one language model as the checker and another (or the same one) as the fixer.

papers.title: A Plug-and-Play 2D Motion Interface for Real-World Motion Language Models
papers.desc: Motion Language Models (MoLMs) typically understand human motions by tokenizing 3D motion and processing the resulting tokens using a language model.

papers.title: WorldRover: A Scalable Synthetic Video Data Engine for World Exploration with Rich Annotations
papers.desc: Learning to generate or reconstruct explorable worlds requires video paired with more than RGB: camera motion, scene geometry, temporal correspondence and, for interactive models, control signals.

papers.title: Prototype-Rectified Iterative Self-supervised Manifold Denoising under Severe Acoustic Shift
papers.desc: Audio-Text Foundation Models (ATMs) fail catastrophically under severe acoustic noise, yet existing adaptation strategies either rely on gradient-based Test-Time Adaptation (TTA), which reinforces noise rather than signal, or on prompt tuning that requires privileged noise annotations unavailable at inference.

papers.title: HiFi-BRep: High-Fidelity Latent Representation for Robust B-Rep Generation
papers.desc: Boundary representation (B-Rep) generation is a fundamental task in computer-aided design, yet the direct synthesis of high-fidelity and structurally valid B-Reps remains a major challenge.
